text:
Priya (partnerships): Quick check — for the upcoming AWS Marketplace + AcmeHW joint announcement, how are we routing SI co-sell leads? want a simple matrix we can ship to field partners. :clipboard:
Diego - SI: We usually claim by account territory first, then by product fit. For cases where SI introduced the deal, SI gets primary.
Marina (sales): Need the SLA too — who owns first outreach and within what window? ops asked for 48h max.
Priya (partnerships): Agree on 48h. Also need account mapping rules when account is shared across territories (global accounts).
Sam (partnerships): Proposal: if ACV < $50k -> Marketplace outbound handled by Redwood rep; if >= $50k -> SI gets co-sell lead and sales engages. For global accounts, priority to field owner in account map unless SI has signed MSA.
Ethan (legal): If SI has an MSA or exclusive reseller clause, they should own the handoff. Otherwise default to account owner. We should require a signed CLA for co-branded announcements.
Diego - SI: Can we codify the decision tree? simple snippet for ops: 
```
if si_has_msa(account): assign_to(SI)
elif account_owner == marketplace_region: assign_to(Redwood_rep)
elif acv >= 50000: assign_to(SI)
else: assign_to(Redwood_rep)
```
Marina (sales): That works. Add exception for "SI sourced demo" where SI gets priority regardless of ACV.
Priya (partnerships): Noted. Action items: 1) Sam to add exception for SI-sourced demos; 2) Diego to update SI intake form to include MSA checkbox + "sourced_demo" checkbox; 3) Marina to confirm 48h SLA language for ops.
Sam (partnerships): I'll draft the matrix and a one-pager for partners. ETA EOD tomorrow.
RedwoodBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in #partnerships in 24h (thread created by Priya).
Marina (sales): Cool — FYI I'll flag two pilot accounts (AcmeCorp, Globex) to validate mapping.
Priya (partnerships): Perfect. If anyone has corner cases (resellers, distributor-led deals) drop them here. :point_down:
Diego - SI: FYI distributor-led should route to channel partner ops, not SI co-sell. I'll add notes.
Priya (partnerships): Thanks all!
